programs.title: Desi Boyz
programs.desc: A comedy-drama film about two friends, who lose their jobs during the recession. They decide to become male escorts to make ends meet, hiding their new profession from their families. However, their lives become more complicated when they fall in love and have to deal with the consequences of their new careers. Their lives take a turn when their secret is exposed, leading to a series of comical situations and misunderstandings.

programs.title: Nh10
programs.desc: Gurgaon professionals Meera and Arjun are shaken after Meera survives a brutal attack. Seeking escape, they take a desert holiday, but at a highway dhaba they witness hoodlums abducting a young girl.

programs.title: Filhaal
programs.desc: When Sia watches her best friend Rewa slip into depression because of her inability to bear a child, she offers to be her surrogate. Trouble brews when jealousy finds its way into their relationship.
